truth: CORE-01A/B/C provide durable Song/version identity, scoped conflict-aware evidence, and append-only Song Activity inside one canonical profile database.
CORE-01C hosted exact-head proof remains UNOBSERVED and is not converted to green or allowed to block unrelated dependency-ready construction.
CORE-01D is the only active product increment and turns canonical memory into a read-only Song Resume Brief for a normal returning artist.

The Resume Brief writes no state, never ranks conflicting evidence, keeps CURRENT separate from APPROVED, excludes other-Song history, and reports next action as UNKNOWN unless represented evidence resolves it.
No new persistence, full Artist Graph, universal search, DAW integration, app shell, or provider execution is selected in this increment.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
